🍿 Jackson Lamb meets Dobby, and it works This season, Gary Oldman (Sirius Black in 'Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban' ) shares scenes with Lenny Rush , the 17-year-old cast as Dobby in the HBO 'Harry Potter' . Lamb ends up shielding a kid whose father was murdered. Cute coincidence, sure. 🧙 What I like is that nobody sells it as a stunt. Rush plays a frightened boy opposite the foulest spy in London, and that's a better pitch than any wand-waving.
